entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2 13-09-2024 Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State.

2. The accused/petitioner is named in the F.I.R. and apprehending his arrest in connection with Sahebpur Kamal P.S. Case No. 320 of 2022 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 120-B, 147, 148, 149, 379, 427, 337, 420, 467, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Sahebpur Kamal P.S. Case No. 320 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. The allegation against the petitioner is to open indiscriminate firing upon informant along with 33 named and 20 unknown co-accused persons, where Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.56497 of 2024(2) dt.13-09-2024 occurrence arises out of previous land dispute with further allegation that accused person including the petitioner took away cash of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty-five Thousand only) from the elder brother of the informant and also snatched golden chain from him.

5. It is submitted by Mr. Sabal Kumar Jha, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner that petitioner has been falsely implicated with the present case out of land dispute arises from a piece of land, bearing Khasra No. 305, 308, 711, 712 and 713 situated in village-Raghunathpur, where both parties appears to be agnate.
It is submitted that allegation is appearing very much general and omnibus against the petitioner.

It is also submitted that similarly situated co- accused persons,
namely, Nepal Rai and Sintu Rai have already granted anticipatory bail by learned Co-ordinate Benches of this Court through Cr. Misc. No. 80224 of 2023 vide order dated 18.12.2023 & Cr. Misc.

sentences.text:
. It is also submitted that co-accused persons, namely, Babulal Rai,
AvdeshKumar, Nitish Kumar @ Rajeev Kumar, Gulshan Kumar @ Kargi, Jitan Rai @ Jitendra Rai and Chunchuna Rai have also granted anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 10.05.2024 passed in Cr. Misc. No.78267 of 2023.

6. Learned APP while opposing the prayer of bail submitted that petitioner actively participated in alleged occurrence.
7.

In view of the facts and circumstances as mentioned above and by taking note of nature of allegation, which is appearing very much general and omnibus against the petitioner, arising out of land dispute, accordingly, above-named petitioner, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the Trial Court within a period of four weeks, is directed to be released on bail, furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.56497 of 2024(2)
dt.13-09-2024 Magistrate-IV, Begusarai/concerned Court where the case is pending in connection with Sahebpur Kamal P.S. Case No. 320 of 2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C./under Section 482(2) of B.N.S.S. (Chandra Shekhar Jha, J.) Sanjeet/-
